fixes.correction: Keep the composition, courtyard, squall, workers, barrels and Nagoji's face, topknot, grey temples, curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, gold ear stud, cream mundu, shoulder cloth and silver chain exactly as they are. fixes.issues: Only candidate v01 fails the continuity bible. Nagoji's face is right: topknot, grey temples, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin and gold ear stud. It reads as a tattoo or a cross symbol, while the bible requires a pale puckered patch of raised ridges with no letters and not a cross. He also has a fresh red cut on his left upper arm that is not in the bible, and the long forearm scar is reddish rather than white. fixes.correction: Keep Nagoji's look exactly as drawn: the loose fold of cream shoulder cloth held over his head with one hand like a rain hood, not wrapped or tied, with the bump of the topknot visible beneath it. Also keep the grey temples, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, cream mundu and silver chain. Keep the rain, laterite walls and workers in the courtyard. The lintel is lower than his head, so he bends at the waist and ducks under it. His body leans forward into the black interior, and his face is in profile or three-quarter, turned toward the darkness ahead. Rain sheets off the tiled eaves directly above and behind him. The doorway ahead is unlit black. On his LEFT forearm the only marks are the old brand and the scar. The brand is a faint, pale, slightly raised and puckered patch of healed burn scar, lighter than the skin, with no dark outline, no ring, no cross and no symbol or letter. The scar is one long, thin WHITE healed line from wrist toward elbow. No tattoos, rosettes or other marks anywhere on his arms.
fixes.issues: Only candidate v01 shows the wrong beat. Nagoji is stepping OUT of a tall dark doorway toward the camera and the rainy courtyard, so the darkness is behind him and the rain is ahead. The script has him ducking INTO a low doorway, with rain behind him and darkness ahead. The lintel is well above his head, so he is not really ducking. His left arm also breaks the bible: a dark rosette tattoo on the upper arm, and the brand drawn as a dark inked ring with a glyph inside, which reads as a tattoo or pseudo-letter rather than a pale puckered burn patch. The cloth hood, visible topknot bump, curled moustache, clean-shaven chin and ear stud are all correct.

fixes.correction: Keep the two-shot: Nagoji stays in the near foreground at frame left, just inside the open door with rain beyond it, water dripping from his hair and cloth onto the swept floor. fixes.issues: Only candidate v01 fails on anatomy and continuity. Ramayyan's raised hand, the key gesture toward the shelves, shows only three spread fingers and no clear thumb. fixes.issues: The framing breaks the script. 3.2 calls for the same hands-only insert as 3.1, but v01 shows Ramayyan's full face and torso holding the leaf upright in mid-air. fixes.correction: Marthanda Varma must read as a young man in his early thirties, clearly younger than at the later dedication. fixes.issues: The split works well: cold grey left half with the dark-cuffed clerk's hand, quill and blank ruled ledger, warm lamp-lit right half with Ramayyan's ink-stained fingers, stylus and palm leaf, no faces and no painted text. There is room for the LEDGER line on the ruled page, for the LEAF line on the leaf left of the stylus, and for captions on the grey wall at top left and the plain table areas. But the clerk's quill ends in a black steel dip-pen nib with a metal collar. That is a 19th-century object in a 1738 Goa ledger, and it sits right where the LEDGER entry is lettered.
